name: Prefix count of bad pairs
whenToUse: Many range questions on the same array. Turn each pair into 1 (bad) or 0 (fine), build a prefix count once, and answer every query with one subtraction.

card.signals: many queries [from, to] on the same array, and each answer only depends on how many "bad" things are inside the range.
card.pattern: a prefix count. Mark every adjacent pair as bad (same parity) or fine. pre[i] = bad pairs inside nums[0..i]. A range is special when it has 0 bad pairs: pre[to] − pre[from] = 0. O(n + q) time.
card.coreIdea: pre[to] counts the bad pairs that end at index 1..to; pre[from] counts those that end at 1..from. Their difference counts the pairs that end in from + 1..to, which are exactly the pairs with both numbers inside nums[from..to].
card.variant: inclusive prefix count over pairs (length n, pre[0] = 0 because index 0 starts no pair). Here pre[from] is subtracted, not pre[from − 1]: the pair (from − 1, from) sticks out of the range, so it must not be counted.

invariant: pre[i] = number of indexes k in 1..i with nums[k] and nums[k − 1] of the same parity.
